items.title: Squeezing Neoclouds Pushes NVIDIA Back Toward Its Rivals
items.snippet: NVIDIA's $107.6b Q3 Data Center business faces a strategic dilemma : hyperscalers ($60.1b) are building custom ASICs to replace NVIDIA GPUs, while neoclouds & frontier labs ($47.5b) build no competing chips but need NVIDIA's balance sheet.
